script: A copy message says: I can design anything for you. A personal message says: I saw your post about the new menu, and I think the photo would look better in a square frame with your logo at the top. That second message shows that you looked at the business. It is short, specific and friendly, and it gives the owner an easy reason to reply. Before you send, read the message once, and remove any word you would not say out loud. If you are unsure about a business, do not send a message at all. Your reputation starts with the first message you send. Set a weekly target. Send fifteen to twenty personal messages a week. Record each one in a simple sheet, with the date, the name, the reply and the next step. Review the sheet every Friday. Recording is what turns outreach into a system.
